channel.title: Nature Materials
channel.description: Nature Materials is a multidisciplinary journal aimed at bringing together cutting-edge research across the entire spectrum of materials science and technology. Nature Materials covers all applied and fundamental aspects of the synthesis/processing, structure/composition, properties and performance of materials. Nature Materials provides a forum for the development of a common identity among materials scientists while encouraging researchers to cross established subdisciplinary lines. To achieve this, Nature Materials takes an interdisciplinary, integrated and balanced approach to all areas of materials research while fostering the exchange of ideas between scientists involved in different communities.

item.title: [7] Spin order steers a light–matter condensate
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Hui Deng

Score 7/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Magneto-optical control in a layered magnetic semiconductor relevant to magnetic topological materials context.

Tags: #magnetism #CrSBr #condensates

Abstract: Light–matter condensates get a magnetic control knob. In the layered magnet CrSBr, reorienting the spins with a modest field shifts the condensate’s colour by more than 10 meV.

item.title: [7] Spatiotemporal intensity-cycling microscopy unveils many-body interactions and correlated transport in van der Waals semiconductors
item.content:encoded:
Last authors: Xavier Roy, Milan Delor

Authors: Jakhangirkhodja A. Tulyagankhodjaev, Michelle E. Reynoso, Yongseok Hong, et al.

Score 7/10 B_IMPORTANT_CONDMAT

Why: Important study on correlated transport and Mott physics in van der Waals materials.

Tags: #vanderWaals #correlated-electrons #Mott

Abstract: Intensity-cycling spatiotemporal microscopy separates single-particle and multi-particle transport, enabling imaging of charge mobility, exciton interactions, and correlated many-body states in van der Waals semiconductors, including Mott transitions.
